spec.template: A wide establishing shot of a small pottery workshop. Shelves of unglazed bowls and a wooden workbench. No teapot visible. Slow camera pan. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

Close-up of a {{prop.color}} glazed ceramic teapot standing on a wooden pottery workbench. The entire teapot remains visible. Slow camera push in. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
A potter shapes a small plain clay bowl on a spinning wheel. No teapot visible. Close-up of hands and wet clay. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

A potter pours water from a {{prop.color}} glazed ceramic teapot into a plain white cup on a wooden workbench. Close-up, the teapot stays clearly visible. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
A wide view of a closed pottery kiln and shelves of raw clay bowls. No teapot visible. Stable camera. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

A {{prop.color}} glazed ceramic teapot sits beside a white cup on a wooden table in a pottery workshop. A hand gently rotates the teapot. Close-up. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
